subject.title: refactor(sessions): replace ambient watch sentinels with provenance

question: Should OpenClaw accept schema v4 now, including automatic v3 migration and refusal by older binaries to open the upgraded database?
rationale: Repository policy treats SQLite schema-version advances as an explicit owner decision, and this PR intentionally changes the upgrade and downgrade contract for durable user state.

options.title: Approve v4 with upgrade proof
options.body: Accept the one-way schema advance after reviewing a real v3-to-v4 migration transcript that confirms preserved cursor semantics and the intended older-binary refusal.

options.title: Retain v3 for now
options.body: Pause this refactor and redesign it without changing the shipped state-schema version if the downgrade boundary is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve v4 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Accept the one-way schema advance after reviewing a real v3-to-v4 migration transcript that confirms preserved cursor semantics and the intended older-binary refusal.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ambient-watch feature and authored the proposed persistence migration, making them the best available owner for the schema-contract decision.
